item.title: Websites taken offline over PHP risks
item.description: The vulnerabilities with PHP, a programming language widely used across the internet, have been described as the most significant ever found by AI. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Reuters, BBC News, Financial Times

item.title: A Democratic Candidate for Governor Is Traversing Alaska to Flip the State
item.description: Democrats are hoping that Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins’s voter outreach could help them win an Alaska governor’s race for the first time since 1998. [Probable] Fuentes: The New York Times, The Guardian

item.title: It's not just gas and groceries. Childcare costs weigh on some voters before the midterm elections
item.description: U.S. families are struggling to afford childcare as costs rise faster than rent, with nearly 8% of households paying over $2,000 a month on daycare, nanny services and other programs. CBS News MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo has the… [Probable] Fuentes: Associated Press, CBS News, ABC News

item.title: La senadora Susan Collins pide la retirada de un anuncio de radio que ataca al demócrata Troy Jackson llamándolo 'creep'
item.description: La carrera al Senado por Maine entre la titular republicana Susan Collins y el demócrata Troy Jackson presenta un laboratorio para el sentimiento público sobre los aranceles de Trump a Canadá. [Probable] Fuentes: Associated Press, CNBC, The Hill

item.title: Florida Mayor Is Accused of Taking Covid Grant Funds She Helped Approve
item.description: Mayor Jackie Espinosa of Kissimmee, Fla., and her family received money from a grant program she helped create during the pandemic, the state attorney general said. She was arrested on Wednesday. [Probable] Fuentes: The New York Times, ABC News
